rationale: CNC is trading at 98.9% of today's range, just $0.07 below the session high of $71.60, after a massive intraday reversal from a low of $65.67. At this extreme position in the range with no news catalyst identified and the stock already up ~9% from the low, the risk/reward for a long is poor — chasing a breakout at the high with only 18 bps spread but significant mean-reversion risk. A short against the high is equally unattractive given the strong momentum and elevated relative volume (3.93x) supporting the move. The setup lacks a clean mechanical edge in either direction at this moment.
